name: keel
description: Sizes tasks, checks plans, reports independent verification evidence, guards dangerous commands and secret files, meters token budgets, stops error loops, and provides selective reversible recovery. Plugin protection is best effort. Adds short learning notes on debugging turns.

interface.shortDescription: Honest, safe and budget-aware coding agents for beginners
interface.longDescription: Keel checks Codex's claims against the real diff and test results, stops repeated-error loops, asks before dangerous commands and secret files, warns at 70%, 90% and 100% of a task's token budget, and keeps checkpoints you can revert to.
